description: Retrieval benchmark: 50 hand-written questions over samples/networks_lecture.pdf (T), samples/network_layer_lecture.pdf (N) and samples/routing_slides.pptx (R). A question is a hit if any retrieved chunk comes from one of its gold (file, page) pairs.

categories.keyword: exact terms, numbers or identifiers that appear in the text
categories.paraphrase: everyday wording that avoids the lecture's keywords
categories.confusable: facts that exist in similar form in another lecture or page
